info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Numbers API

params.name: number
params.description: Query information for a specific number.

params.name: maxpagesize
params.description: Maximum number of records to include in a single response. Defaults to 200, and must not exceed 500.

params.name: skip
params.description: An offset into the collection of the first record to be returned.

items.docs: Gets a list of all configured numbers across all accounts. Response pagination can be controlled with a combination of the maxpagesize and skip parameters. Limit the number of records in a response with the maxpagesize parameter. Specify the starting record using the skip parameter.
